entries.1aa5dfd69ef819ae: A reportable segment that manufactures and sells "preforms," the base material of PET bottles, and plastic caps, and also provides related services. It is handled by ALTECH Shin-Zairyo Co., Ltd. (Sakai, Fukui Prefecture) and consolidated subsidiaries in Suzhou, Guangzhou, Chongqing and Wuhan in China. Net sales for the fiscal year ended November 2025 were ¥8,618 million (down 9.5% from the previous year), and the segment loss was ¥523 million (compared with a loss of ¥530 million in the previous year). Net sales include internal transactions between segments. The securities report states that the decrease in sales was due to lower sales volume of beverage preforms and lower sales of recycled flake material. The company withdrew from the recycled flake business during this fiscal year.

It has the largest sales to external customers of the 2 reportable segments. The company and 3 consolidated subsidiaries in Thailand, Indonesia and Vietnam are in charge. In the fiscal year ended November 2025, revenue was ¥9,006 million (up 2.8% from the previous year) and segment profit was ¥768 million (up 22.2% from the previous year). Revenue is the amount including internal transactions between segments. The securities report states that although there was a reactionary decline from the next-generation hybrid conference system, which performed well in the previous year, the completion of acceptance inspection of large machinery such as tube manufacturing machines, food processing machinery and water treatment equipment, and the delivery of the small electric bus "e-JEST" to Minamiboso City, Chiba Prefecture, led to higher revenue.
